messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — Audit Viewer users hitting 403 when exporting console audit JSON/CSV for customers that have actor metadata encrypted with their KMS.
aj: saw this yesterday with a service principal that didn't have kms:Decrypt. Logs show `AccessDeniedException` from KMS.
samir: can you paste the export-service error payload?
maria.g: ```
2026-02-14T18:02:11Z export-service ERROR exportRequest failed: status=403 reason=KMS:AccessDenied error="AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:iam::123456:role/export-service lacks kms:Decrypt on alias/customer-key"
stack=...
request_id=abc-123
```
leah: UX issue: users start a big export, it streams for a while then fails — terrible experience. We should preflight.
aj: agree. Proposed fix: add a small preflight endpoint that checks (1) RBAC export permission, (2) ability to call kms:Decrypt with the effective principal, (3) estimated result size. If any check fails return actionable error.
samir: paging quirk too — when export iterates by pages we end up with inconsistent CSV lengths if a page fails mid-stream. We should switch export to object-streaming and checkpoint with resume tokens, not resend page offsets.
maria.g: short-term mitigation: catch KMS decrypt errors and fall back to redacted actor fields ("[REDACTED]") rather than failing whole export. Need product sign-off for exposing partial redaction.
leah: also need clearer error copy: not "403" but "Export blocked: missing KMS decrypt permissions for customer key — contact account admin" and a "Preflight failed" CTA with explainers.
audit-bot: Incident INC-4538 created for export failures (severity=medium). Link: https://infra.internal/incidents/INC-4538
opsoncall: tagging infra — can you confirm service role policies for export-service? we might be missing cross-account kms:Decrypt on customer-managed keys.
aj: I'll open SEC-1029 with proposed preflight API + fallback redaction + streaming change. I'll include a small migration: preflight runs a dry-run decrypt using `kms:GenerateDataKey` with Condition arn:aws:kms:xxx to validate.
leah: :thumbsup: I'll draft UX copy and modal flow, include a toggle "Export with redaction" for viewers.
samir: quick note for implementers — log preflight result in audit logs as `export.preflight.{ok|failed}` with reason codes so customers can see why export failed.
maria.g: thanks — please ping when SEC-1029 lands, I'll coordinate with support for customer callbacks.
aj: putting a patch on my queue, ETA EOW for a minimal preflight + graceful-redact rollback.
leah: cool — will own the error messaging and product docs.
opsoncall: added a short runbook to INC-4538 with mitigation steps and KMS policy checklist.
